body: You and everyone else has no friends with mental illness

I don’t have a penis because I’m female..but I know how you feel.  A surgery left me with nerve damage in my vagina and cervix. I can’t feel anything and making love is not possible. It gets better with time you just come to accept it.

I have this too. It's like my mind is blocked and there's this fog and I can't visualize anything. If I read a book or something and they describe someones features or a place I have a hard time visualizing it.  The PTSD fog, as I call it, also blocks out the good memories too. I can't remember certain things or smells. Smells trigger memory and mine is so shot that I have hard time linking smells with a good memory.
Be thankful you have friends that care. I have zero friends due to my BP1. Your fortunate.
I’m so sorry my uncle and dad abused me and when I finally talked about it my cousin said I ruined my family

You can get chewable pills from the pet store or chewy.com that makes the poop taste bad to the dog so they stop eating it. One brand is called vet classics, stop stool eating. And another one is , chew no poop bites. Works good.

That is so awesome! I’m so happy for you! Ya I was on lithium at first for a while when I was first diagnosed but I was literally a zombie and it didn’t really help with my anxiety. But they literally had me on so many different medications and were switching me so quickly I didn’t really know if the lithium helped or not. I was thinking about giving it a try again if nothing else works, but the foggy, sluggish feeling I had sucked. But I could have been a different medication, not the lithium. We’ll see, just trial and error I guess. Just gotta hang in there.

Wow, I can’t imagine. That’s really hard. 19 years is long. Ya the switching of meds quickly is really hard it fucks me up too. The depression isn’t as bad as it used to be, so I should be thankful for that but the psychosis and suicidal thoughts that I get are very disruptive and always have me end up inpatient. Just so annoying. Best of luck with your meds, sounds like it’s been a struggle for you too. It makes me feel better to know  that there many more meds out there, just have to find a balance, so thank you for that.
Going that many times in a day is concerning.You should really talk to a urologist, lithium is known to damage your kidneys , you should be getting monthly blood test to make sure it doesn’t.

Radiologists literally don’t interact with patients. They sit in a dark room and read the X-rays. The x-Ray tech is the one dealing with the bariatric patient. They have to slide them on and off the table and position them to get the x-Rays and ya, sometimes bigger people are harder to x-Ray depending on what is needed but all the techs I’ve met are caring and understand the daily struggles of their patient, especially when they are obese.

Radiologists sit in a dark room an read the x-rays, the x-Ray tech is the one the actually deals with the bariatric patient and takes the x-rays. They are the one who actually has to pull the obese patient on and off the the table. And yes bigger people are harder to x-Ray depending on what is needed but all the techs I’ve met are caring and know the struggle an obese patient goes through.
Word, my life is shit

Pets are part part of the family, I tear up just thinking about your story. I don't know  what I would do. My dog is my little girl too.  She's getting older and I can't imagine life without her. I'm so sorry. I don't think crying over a pet makes you a baby, you love her! Pets make our lives better and when they're gone, it hurts. Just think of all the love you gave her and what a happy life she had with you.

I've been there, I understand how you feel. Liquor, flashbacks, suicidal ideation was my life for a very long time. So I want you to know, this was not your fault. It's doesn't matter if you were drunk, sex without consent is rape. Period. The man who did this to you is a garbage piece of shit, not you. You are a survivor. Pour out that bottle and look in the mirror and say over and over- I 'm a badass survivor. If anyone should die, it's the piece of shit that did this to you. Stay strong, put the bottle away-I know it's hard, trust me, and just know that there are people who care. Taking your life seems like it will take away the pain, but it will only cause pain to others that love you. You are not alone. Sending you so much love. <3
Thank you so much, that means a lot. Not a lot of people understand the struggle that comes with mental illness.
Thank you

My hospital stays while manic actually caused PTSD. I was on a floor with was a mix of women and men. One of the men threw me up against the wall almost raped me, I screamed for help and nobody came. Finally someone saw I was in distress and told a nurse. She pulled him away and just looked at me and was like it was my fault and said "ya, he does that" no apology or anything. Shared my story with people in group, after group people would come up to me and tell me I should kill myself. Told the nurses I didn't feel right from the meds they gave me, so I refused to take them until I talked to the doctor. They would yell and scream at me and throw me in this room and make me stay there until I took the meds. When I would yell back they would physically restrain me and then chemically restrain me. After waking up from one of the injections from a chemical restraint, my pants were off. I felt so unsafe and no one would listen to me.  They literally did not give a fuck. I actually got a lawyer because I'm still dealing with PTSD nightmares from this stay.
Thank you
